remarks:
Thoughtfully designed with exceptional attention to detail, this home showcases tray ceilings and gleaming luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout.

The open-concept layout is enhanced by a bright sunroom featuring vaulted ceilings and a half wall with Craftsman-style columns, along with expansive windows that create a warm and inviting space—perfect for relaxing near the gas fireplace. A 21' x 10' covered rear porch extends the living space outdoors for added enjoyment.

The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, complete with upgraded cabinetry featuring dovetail construction and soft-close drawers, crown molding, quartz countertops, and a ceramic tile backsplash.

The private primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring double sinks and ceramic tile shower.

Enjoy the ease of low-maintenance living with landscaping and snow removal included through the association, allowing more time to relax and enjoy your home.

Taxes TBD.
